class: Known current clearance denial not resolved for possession questions
symptom: The agent asked for help on current/active clearance and required TS/SCI possession despite the explicit saved No clearance fact.
root_cause: Possession wording had no deterministic profile resolution and fell through to unavailable AI.
why_tests_missed: Generic current possession and a named required clearance were not covered together.
fix: Use explicit No current clearance only for direct have/possess-clearance questions. Past-clearance, willingness and objections remain distinct questions.
prevention: Keep negative qualification facts scoped to the exact question being answered.
